scripts.native:add:ios: npm run build && cap add ios --packagemanager SPM
scripts.native:sync:ios: npm run build && cap sync ios && npm run native:verify:ios
scripts.native:build:ios: npm run native:sync:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .native-build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=YES CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=YES build && npm run native:verify:simulator:ios
scripts.native:preflight:ios: npm run native:sync:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath .native-build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build && npm run native:verify:built:ios
scripts.native:add:android: npm run build && cap add android
scripts.native:sync:android: npm run build && cap sync android && npm run native:verify:android
scripts.native:build:android: npm run native:sync:android && node scripts/build-android.mjs debug
scripts.native:preflight:android: npm run native:sync:android && node scripts/build-android.mjs release && node scripts/verify-android-built-app.mjs android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
